title: Intercession of Christ
definition: The intercession of Christ is His ongoing priestly work of representing, praying for, and sustaining His people before the Father.
summary: Jesus lives to intercede for His people.
christFocus: The risen Christ represents believers before God and secures their ongoing help and preservation.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Christ's saving work did not end with His death and resurrection. He lives and intercedes for His people. His intercession rests on His finished sacrifice.

Jesus represents believers before the Father, not because the Father is reluctant to love them, but because salvation is secured through the Son's priestly work.

His intercession gives assurance to weak believers who still struggle, stumble, and need mercy.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: Many believers fear that their weakness will cause Christ to abandon them. The intercession of Christ matters because He continually represents and keeps His people.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Come boldly to God through Christ. When you feel weak or accused, remember that your Savior lives to intercede for you.
